title_original: Straßenverkehrsgesetz (StVG) §§ 1a–1l – Kraftfahrzeuge mit hoch-/vollautomatisierter Fahrfunktion und mit autonomer Fahrfunktion
title_en: Road Traffic Act (StVG) sections 1a–1l – motor vehicles with highly/fully automated driving function and with autonomous driving function
notes: Consolidated StVG: 2017 provisions on SAE L3 automated driving (driver duties, data recorder) and 2021 provisions on L4 autonomous driving in defined operating areas (technical supervisor).

title_original: Achtes Gesetz zur Änderung des Straßenverkehrsgesetzes vom 16. Juni 2017 (BGBl. I S. 1648)
title_en: Eighth Act amending the Road Traffic Act of 16 June 2017 (automated driving)
notes: Amending act that inserted §§1a–1c and §63a StVG: permits highly/fully automated driving functions, driver rights/duties, event data storage, higher liability caps.

title_original: Gesetz zur Änderung des Straßenverkehrsgesetzes und des Pflichtversicherungsgesetzes – Gesetz zum autonomen Fahren vom 12. Juli 2021 (BGBl. I S. 3108)
title_en: Act amending the Road Traffic Act and the Compulsory Insurance Act – Act on Autonomous Driving of 12 July 2021
notes: First national law for SAE Level 4 driverless vehicles in regular operation within approved operating areas; defines technical supervision, duties of keeper and manufacturer, data handling.

title_original: Verordnung zur Genehmigung und zum Betrieb von Kraftfahrzeugen mit autonomer Fahrfunktion in festgelegten Betriebsbereichen (Autonome-Fahrzeuge-Genehmigungs-und-Betriebs-Verordnung – AFGBV) vom 24. Juni 2022
title_en: Ordinance on the approval and operation of motor vehicles with autonomous driving function in defined operating areas (AFGBV) of 24 June 2022
issuer: Bundesministerium für Digitales und Verkehr / Bundesrat
notes: Implementing ordinance for the 2021 Act: KBA operating permit, technical requirements, functional description, cybersecurity, technical supervisor qualification, data for L4 vehicles.

title_original: Bericht der Ethik-Kommission Automatisiertes und Vernetztes Fahren (BMVI, Juni 2017)
title_en: Report of the Ethics Commission on Automated and Connected Driving (June 2017)
notes: 20 ethical rules for automated driving (dilemma situations, no discrimination by personal features, human control, data sovereignty); English edition hosted by the Federal Ministry of Transport.

title_original: Luftverkehrs-Ordnung (LuftVO) Abschnitt 5a – Betrieb von unbemannten Fluggeräten (§§ 21a–21k)
title_en: Air Traffic Regulation (LuftVO) section 5a – operation of unmanned aircraft systems (sections 21a–21k)
notes: National UAS operating rules (introduced by the 2017 drone ordinance, recast 2021 to implement EU 2019/947): geographic zones, operating bans, remote-ID, registration, competence certificates.

title_original: Verordnung zur Regelung des Betriebs von unbemannten Fluggeräten vom 30. März 2017 (BGBl. I S. 683)
title_en: Ordinance regulating the operation of unmanned aircraft of 30 March 2017 (drone ordinance)
issuer: Bundesministerium für Verkehr und digitale Infrastruktur / Bundesrat
notes: Germany's first comprehensive drone ordinance: labelling duty, knowledge certificate, 100 m altitude cap, no-fly zones; largely replaced by 2021 LuftVO recast under EU rules.

title_original: Luftverkehrsgesetz (LuftVG) – Regelungen für unbemannte Fluggeräte / unbemannte Luftfahrtsysteme (u.a. §1 Abs. 2, §21h ff.)
title_en: Aviation Act (LuftVG) – provisions on unmanned aircraft systems (as amended 2021 to implement EU UAS rules)
notes: Statutory basis for UAS and 'Flugtaxis' in German airspace; 2021 amendment (Gesetz zur Anpassung nationaler Regelungen an EU 2019/947) created competences for Luftfahrt-Bundesamt and geographic zones.

title_original: DGUV Information 209-074 „Industrieroboter“
title_en: DGUV Information 209-074 'Industrial robots' (safety of collaborative and industrial robot workplaces)
notes: Accident-insurance guidance on risk assessment and protective measures for industrial and collaborative robot cells (based on EN ISO 10218 / ISO/TS 15066).

title_original: Robotik für gute Pflege – Stellungnahme des Deutschen Ethikrates (10. März 2020)
title_en: Robotics for good care – Opinion of the German Ethics Council (10 March 2020)
notes: Statutory ethics council opinion with recommendations on use of care robots: no replacement of human care, autonomy and consent of care recipients, funding and research conditions.

title_original: Mensch und Maschine – Herausforderungen durch Künstliche Intelligenz. Stellungnahme des Deutschen Ethikrates (2023)
title_en: Humans and Machines – Challenges of Artificial Intelligence. Opinion of the German Ethics Council (2023)
notes: Broad AI opinion with sector chapters incl. medicine/care and public administration; addresses delegation to machines and embodied assistive systems; general-AI relevance only.

title_original: Bericht der Enquete-Kommission Künstliche Intelligenz – Gesellschaftliche Verantwortung und wirtschaftliche, soziale und ökologische Potenziale (BT-Drs. 19/23700)
title_en: Report of the Bundestag Study Commission on Artificial Intelligence (BT-Drs. 19/23700, 2020)
notes: Parliamentary study commission final report with project-group chapters on AI in mobility (automated driving), health/care robotics and work; recommendations to legislature.

title_original: Deutsche Normungsroadmap Künstliche Intelligenz, Ausgabe 2 (DIN/DKE 2022)
title_en: German Standardization Roadmap on Artificial Intelligence, Edition 2 (DIN/DKE 2022)
issuer: DIN e.V. und DKE (im Auftrag des BMWK)
notes: Government-commissioned standardization roadmap with working groups on mobility (automated driving), industrial automation/robotics and medicine; identifies standards needs for embodied AI.

title_original: Ordonnance n° 2016-1057 du 3 août 2016 relative à l'expérimentation de véhicules à délégation de conduite sur les voies publiques
title_en: Ordinance No. 2016-1057 of 3 August 2016 on the experimentation of vehicles with delegated driving on public roads
issuer: Gouvernement (Président de la République) – Ministère de l'environnement/transports
notes: Requires ministerial authorisation for any on-road test of partially or fully automated vehicles; basis for décret 2018-211; amended by loi PACTE 2019 to allow tests without driver on board.

title_original: Décret n° 2018-211 du 28 mars 2018 relatif à l'expérimentation de véhicules à délégation de conduite sur les voies publiques
title_en: Decree No. 2018-211 of 28 March 2018 on the experimentation of vehicles with delegated driving on public roads
issuer: Premier ministre / Ministère chargé des transports
notes: Sets authorisation procedure (max 2 years renewable), consultations, WW DPTC provisional registration, human driver able to retake control, data recording, suspension powers for AV tests.

title_original: Loi n° 2019-1428 du 24 décembre 2019 d'orientation des mobilités (LOM) – articles 31 et 32 (véhicules autonomes et véhicules connectés)
title_en: Law No. 2019-1428 of 24 December 2019 on mobility orientation (LOM) – articles 31–32 on autonomous and connected vehicles
notes: Empowers the government to legislate by ordinance on liability and use conditions for automated vehicles and automated road transport systems; data access provisions for connected vehicles.

title_original: Ordonnance n° 2021-443 du 14 avril 2021 relative au régime de responsabilité pénale applicable en cas de circulation d'un véhicule à délégation de conduite et à ses conditions d'utilisation
title_en: Ordinance No. 2021-443 of 14 April 2021 on the criminal liability regime for the circulation of vehicles with delegated driving and their conditions of use
issuer: Gouvernement – Ministère de la transition écologique (transports)
notes: Shifts criminal liability to the manufacturer while the automated driving system is engaged; amends Code de la route (L.123-1 ff.), Code des transports (automated road transport systems) and Code.

title_original: Décret n° 2021-873 du 29 juin 2021 portant application de l'ordonnance n° 2021-443 du 14 avril 2021 relative au régime de responsabilité pénale applicable en cas de circulation d'un véhicule à délégation de conduite et à ses conditions d'utilisation
title_en: Decree No. 2021-873 of 29 June 2021 implementing Ordinance No. 2021-443 on criminal liability and conditions of use of vehicles with delegated driving
issuer: Premier ministre / Ministère chargé des transports
notes: Defines partially/highly/fully automated vehicles, driver duties during delegation, conditions of use information, remote operator rules and safety demonstration for automated road transport systems.

title_original: Loi n° 2016-1428 du 24 octobre 2016 relative au renforcement de la sécurité de l'usage des drones civils
title_en: Law No. 2016-1428 of 24 October 2016 on strengthening the safety of civil drone use
notes: Civil drone law: registration of UAS above 800 g, remote pilot training, electronic/light signalling, flight-limitation devices, criminal sanctions for overflying prohibited zones.

title_original: Pour une intelligence artificielle maîtrisée, utile et démystifiée – Rapport OPECST n° 464 (Sénat, 2016-2017)
title_en: For a controlled, useful and demystified artificial intelligence – OPECST report No. 464 (Senate, 2017)
issuer: Office parlementaire d'évaluation des choix scientifiques et technologiques (OPECST)
notes: Parliamentary science office report (de Ganay/Gillot) with 15 proposals on AI and robotics incl. autonomous vehicles, robot ethics and refusal of legal personality for robots.

title_original: Verordnung vom 13. Dezember 2024 über das automatisierte Fahren (VAF), SR 741.59
title_en: Ordinance of 13 December 2024 on Automated Driving (VAF), SR 741.59
notes: In force 1 March 2025: permits motorway autopilot (hands-off), driverless vehicles on approved routes with remote supervision, and automated parking; approval and operator duties.

title_original: Strassenverkehrsgesetz (SVG) – Änderung vom 17. März 2023 (automatisiertes Fahren, Art. 25a ff.), AS 2023 453
title_en: Road Traffic Act (SVG) – amendment of 17 March 2023 on automated driving (art. 25a ff.), AS 2023 453
notes: Delegates to the Federal Council the power to exempt vehicles with automation systems from driver duties; legal basis for VAF; parts in force from 2025 per partial entry-into-force ordinances AS.

title_original: Botschaft zur Änderung des Strassenverkehrsgesetzes (BBl 2021 3026)
title_en: Federal Council Message on the amendment of the Road Traffic Act (BBl 2021 3026) – automated driving
notes: Explanatory message to Parliament proposing the SVG framework for automated and driverless vehicles (liability, remote operators, data recording).

title_original: Verordnung des UVEK vom 24. November 2022 über Luftfahrzeuge besonderer Kategorien (VLK), SR 748.941
title_en: DETEC Ordinance of 24 November 2022 on Aircraft of Special Categories (VLK), SR 748.941 – national drone rules
issuer: Eidgenössisches Departement für Umwelt, Verkehr, Energie und Kommunikation (UVEK)
notes: National implementation of EU UAS rules (2019/947) adopted by Switzerland from 1 Jan 2023: operating conditions for drones, geographic zones, model aircraft associations.

title_original: Decreto del Ministero delle Infrastrutture e dei Trasporti 28 febbraio 2018, n. 70 – Modalità attuative e strumenti operativi della sperimentazione su strada delle soluzioni di Smart Road e di guida connessa e automatica (GU n. 90 del 18-04-2018)
title_en: Ministerial Decree of 28 February 2018 'Smart Road' – implementing procedures for on-road testing of Smart Road solutions and connected and automated driving
issuer: Ministero delle Infrastrutture e dei Trasporti
notes: Authorisation regime for testing automated vehicles on public roads (supervisor on board, insurance, data), Smart Road functional specifications, and a technical Observatory at MIT.

title_original: Legge 27 dicembre 2017, n. 205 (Legge di bilancio 2018), art. 1 comma 72 – sperimentazione su strada di veicoli a guida automatica / Smart Road
title_en: Law No. 205 of 27 December 2017 (Budget Law 2018), art. 1 para. 72 – authorisation of on-road testing of automated vehicles
notes: Statutory basis authorising experimentation of automated driving on public roads and delegating implementing rules to the Smart Road ministerial decree.

title_original: Regolamento ENAC UAS-IT, Edizione 1 del 4 gennaio 2021
title_en: ENAC Regulation UAS-IT, Edition 1 of 4 January 2021 (national unmanned aircraft systems regulation)
notes: National complement to EU 2019/947: registration, remote pilot competence, national standard scenarios, geographic zones; replaced the 2013 'Mezzi Aerei a Pilotaggio Remoto' regulation.

title_original: Legge 23 settembre 2025, n. 132 – Disposizioni e deleghe al Governo in materia di intelligenza artificiale
title_en: Law No. 132 of 23 September 2025 – Provisions and delegations to the Government on artificial intelligence
notes: Italy's national AI law (in force 10 Oct 2025): sector rules for health (AI as support to clinicians, medical devices), work, professions, and delegations incl. criminal law; embodied relevance.

title_original: Instrucción DGT 15/V-113 – Autorización de pruebas o ensayos de investigación realizados con vehículos de conducción automatizada en vías abiertas al tráfico en general
title_en: DGT Instruction 15/V-113 – Authorisation of research tests or trials with automated driving vehicles on roads open to general traffic
notes: Spain's first AV testing framework (automation levels, applicant requirements, authorised road sections, national-scope authorisations); annex amended by Directriz SGGMT 7/2020.

title_original: Instrucción DGT VEH 2022/07 – Procedimiento de autorización de pruebas o ensayos de investigación con vehículos automatizados en vías abiertas; centros de reconocimiento tecnológico
title_en: DGT Instruction VEH 2022/07 – Procedure for authorising research tests with automated vehicles on open roads; technological recognition centres
notes: Updated AV testing procedure introducing certification of test vehicles by technological recognition centres and the 'etiqueta tecnológica' for automated vehicles under test.

title_original: Real Decreto 1036/2017, de 15 de diciembre, por el que se regula la utilización civil de las aeronaves pilotadas por control remoto
title_en: Royal Decree 1036/2017 of 15 December regulating the civil use of remotely piloted aircraft
notes: Spain's national RPAS regulation: operator registration, pilot requirements, urban/night/BVLOS operations, state RPAS; partially superseded by EU 2019/947 and later national UAS decree.

title_original: Wet van 26 september 2018 tot wijziging van de Wegenverkeerswet 1994 in verband met mogelijk maken van experimenten met geautomatiseerde systemen in motorrijtuigen (Experimenteerwet zelfrijdende auto's), Stb. 2018, 347
title_en: Act of 26 September 2018 amending the Road Traffic Act 1994 to enable experiments with automated systems in motor vehicles (Self-driving Cars Experiments Act), Stb. 2018, 347
issuer: Staten-Generaal / Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat
notes: Adds art. 149aa ff. to the Wegenverkeerswet allowing ministerial permits for on-road experiments with self-driving vehicles without a driver on board (remote operator); in force 1 July 2019 (Stb..

title_original: Regeling vergunningverlening experimenten zelfrijdende auto (Stcrt. 2019, 34245)
title_en: Regulation on permit issuance for experiments with self-driving cars (Stcrt. 2019, 34245)
notes: Ministerial regulation implementing the Experimenteerwet: application content, RDW assessment, safety and remote-operation requirements for driverless experiments.

title_original: Autonome wapensystemen: de noodzaak van betekenisvolle menselijke controle (AIV/CAVV advies nr. 97/26, 2015)
title_en: Autonomous weapon systems: the need for meaningful human control (AIV/CAVV advisory report No. 97/26, 2015)
issuer: Adviesraad Internationale Vraagstukken (AIV) en Commissie van Advies inzake Volkenrechtelijke Vraagstukken (CAVV)
notes: Statutory advisory report that shaped the Dutch position on LAWS: 'meaningful human control' in the wider loop, no moratorium; endorsed by the government in 2016.

title_original: Autonome wapensystemen: het belang van reguleren en investeren (AIV/CAVV advies, 2021)
title_en: Autonomous weapon systems: the importance of regulation and investment (AIV/CAVV advisory report, 2021)
notes: Follow-up advisory report recommending a ban on fully autonomous weapons outside meaningful human control and regulation of partially autonomous systems; basis for 2022 government position.

title_original: REAIM 2023 Call to Action (Summit on Responsible Artificial Intelligence in the Military Domain, The Hague, 16 February 2023)
title_en: REAIM 2023 Call to Action on responsible AI in the military domain (The Hague, 16 February 2023)
issuer: Government of the Netherlands (co-hosted with Republic of Korea)
notes: Political declaration endorsed by 60+ states on responsible development and use of military AI incl. autonomous systems; human responsibility and accountability.

title_original: Code de bonnes pratiques d'expérimentation des véhicules autonomes en Belgique / Code of practice for testing autonomous vehicles in Belgium (SPF Mobilité et Transports, septembre 2016)
title_en: Code of practice for testing autonomous vehicles in Belgium (FPS Mobility and Transport, September 2016)
issuer: SPF Mobilité et Transports / FOD Mobiliteit en Vervoer
notes: Non-binding guidance (modelled on UK 2015 code) for organisations testing automated vehicles on Belgian public roads; authorisation by FPS and regional road authority; driver on board (relaxed 2018).

title_original: Arrêté royal du 10 avril 2016 relatif à l'utilisation des aéronefs télépilotés dans l'espace aérien belge
title_en: Royal Decree of 10 April 2016 on the use of remotely piloted aircraft in Belgian airspace
notes: Belgium's first civil drone regulation (class 1/class 2 RPAS, pilot licences, registration, operating limits); replaced by EU 2019/947 framework and the Royal Decree of 8 Nov 2020.

title_original: Proposition de résolution visant à interdire l'utilisation de « robots tueurs » et de drones armés par la Défense belge (DOC 54 3203/001, 27 juin 2018)
title_en: Proposal for a resolution to ban the use of 'killer robots' and armed drones by Belgian Defence (DOC 54 3203/001, 27 June 2018)
notes: Chamber resolution (adopted July 2018, text 3203/006) calling on the government to support an international ban on fully autonomous lethal weapons and to refrain from acquiring them.

title_original: Proposition de résolution visant l'intégration de la définition des véhicules automatisés dans le Code de la route, la poursuite des tests relatifs aux véhicules automatisés en Belgique... (DOC 55 1848/001, 10 mars 2021)
title_en: Proposal for a resolution on integrating the definition of automated vehicles into the Highway Code and continuing automated-vehicle testing in Belgium (DOC 55 1848/001, 10 March 2021)
notes: Parliamentary resolution proposal asking the federal government to define automated vehicles in the Code de la route, continue AV tests and assess infrastructure and environmental effects.

title_original: 11/2017. (IV. 12.) NFM rendelet a fejlesztési célú járművek tesztelésével kapcsolatos szabályozásról (a közúti járművek műszaki megvizsgálásáról szóló 5/1990. és 6/1990. KöHÉM rendeletek módosítása)
title_en: Decree 11/2017 (IV. 12.) NFM of the Minister of National Development on the testing of development-purpose (autonomous) vehicles
notes: Allows testing of automated driving functions on Hungarian public roads after developer registration with the ministry, closed-track pre-test and reporting; developer bears liability.

title_original: Ustawa z dnia 11 stycznia 2018 r. o elektromobilności i paliwach alternatywnych (Dz.U. 2018 poz. 317) – art. 65k–65n Prawa o ruchu drogowym (testy pojazdów autonomicznych)
title_en: Act of 11 January 2018 on electromobility and alternative fuels (Dz.U. 2018 item 317) – inserting arts. 65k–65n into the Road Traffic Act on testing autonomous vehicles
notes: Created Poland's legal framework for research tests of autonomous vehicles on public roads: permit from the road traffic authority, insurance, consultation of residents, reporting duty.

title_original: Rozporządzenie Ministra Infrastruktury z dnia 17 października 2018 r. w sprawie wzoru sprawozdania z prac badawczych związanych z testowaniem pojazdów autonomicznych oraz ich wyposażenia (Dz.U. 2018 poz. 2023)
title_en: Regulation of the Minister of Infrastructure of 17 October 2018 on the template report on research related to testing autonomous vehicles and their equipment (Dz.U. 2018 item 2023)
notes: Implementing regulation under art. 65n Road Traffic Act prescribing the AV test report template; repealed 24 June 2026 following the 2025 amendment act.

title_original: Ustawa z dnia 21 listopada 2025 r. o zmianie ustawy – Prawo o ruchu drogowym oraz niektórych innych ustaw (Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1843) – pojazdy zautomatyzowane, Krajowy Koordynator Prac Badawczych
title_en: Act of 21 November 2025 amending the Road Traffic Act and certain other acts (Dz.U. 2025 item 1843) – automated vehicles and national research coordinator
notes: Reforms the AV testing regime (SAE L3–L5), establishes the National Research Coordinator (KKPB) and new permit procedure; in force 24 June 2026 (content inferred from secondary sources).

title_original: Plán autonomní mobility do roku 2025 s výhledem do roku 2030 (usnesení vlády č. 234 ze dne 10. dubna 2024)
title_en: Autonomous Mobility Plan until 2025 with a Prospect to 2030 (Government Resolution No. 234 of 10 April 2024)
notes: Government-approved action plan for automated road vehicles: legislative measures (amendment of Act 361/2000), testing, infrastructure, liability and data; follows the 2017 Vision for autonomous.

title_original: Liiklusseaduse muutmise seadus (robotliikur) – vastu võetud 14. juunil 2017; Liiklusseadus § 2 p 69¹ jt
title_en: Traffic Act amendment of 14 June 2017 introducing the 'self-driving delivery robot' (robotliikur) vehicle category
notes: First EU national law legalising sidewalk delivery robots (max 6 km/h, 50 kg, insurance, identification marking, remote or direct human control); English consolidated Traffic Act.

title_original: Tam Otonom Araçların Otonom Sürüş Sistemine İlişkin Motorlu Araçların Tip Onayı Hakkında Yönetmelik (AB/2022/1426) – Resmî Gazete 1 Aralık 2024, Sayı 32739
title_en: Regulation on Type Approval of Motor Vehicles regarding the Automated Driving System of Fully Autonomous Vehicles (EU/2022/1426) – Official Gazette No. 32739 of 1 December 2024
notes: Transposes EU Implementing Regulation 2022/1426: type-approval procedures and test rules for automated driving systems of fully automated M/N vehicles (robotaxis, shuttles, automated valet parking).

title_original: Autonome Waffensysteme – Position Österreichs (BMEIA, Abrüstung konventioneller Waffen)
title_en: Autonomous weapons systems – Austria's official position (Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs)
issuer: Bundesministerium für europäische und internationale Angelegenheiten (BMEIA)
notes: Formal national position: meaningful human control required, red line against algorithms deciding over life and death; Austria led 2023 UNGA resolution and hosted the 2024 Vienna conference.

title_original: Strategie automatisiertes und vernetztes Fahren – Leitanbieter bleiben, Leitmarkt werden, Regelbetrieb einleiten (BMVI, September 2015)
title_en: Strategy for Automated and Connected Driving – Remain a lead provider, become a lead market, introduce regular operations (BMVI, September 2015)
issuer: Bundesministerium für Verkehr und digitale Infrastruktur (BMVI)
notes: Federal strategy with fields of action: infrastructure, law (Vienna Convention/StVG reform), innovation, connectivity, cybersecurity/data; launched the German legal reform for automated driving.

title_original: Loi n° 2015-992 du 17 août 2015 relative à la transition énergétique pour la croissance verte – article 37 IX (habilitation à légiférer sur les véhicules à délégation de conduite)
title_en: Law No. 2015-992 of 17 August 2015 on energy transition for green growth – article 37 IX (authorisation to legislate by ordinance on vehicles with delegated driving)
notes: Statutory habilitation enabling the 2016 ordinance on experimentation of automated vehicles on public roads.

title_original: Arrêté du 17 avril 2018 relatif à l'expérimentation de véhicules à délégation de conduite sur les voies publiques
title_en: Order of 17 April 2018 on the experimentation of vehicles with delegated driving on public roads
issuer: Ministre chargé des transports et ministre de l'intérieur
notes: Sets the content of the AV test application file, WW DPTC certificate rules, monitoring and reporting requirements (NOR TRER1717820A).

title_original: Loi n° 2019-486 du 22 mai 2019 relative à la croissance et la transformation des entreprises (PACTE) – article 125 (expérimentation de véhicules à délégation de conduite)
title_en: Law No. 2019-486 of 22 May 2019 on business growth and transformation (PACTE) – article 125 on automated vehicle experimentation
notes: Amends ordinance 2016-1057: allows tests without driver on board under remote supervision, exempts driver from attention duty while system active, assigns fines/criminal liability to the.

title_original: Ordonnance n° 2021-442 du 14 avril 2021 relative à l'accès aux données des véhicules
title_en: Ordinance No. 2021-442 of 14 April 2021 on access to vehicle data
issuer: Gouvernement – Ministère de la transition écologique (transports)
notes: Creates a Code des transports chapter on access to data of connected and automated vehicles (accident investigation, road operators, insurers); companion to ordinance 2021-443.

title_original: Décret n° 2022-1034 du 21 juillet 2022 portant publication de l'amendement à la convention internationale sur la circulation routière de Vienne du 8 novembre 1968 (systèmes de conduite automatisée)
title_en: Decree No. 2022-1034 of 21 July 2022 publishing the amendment to the 1968 Vienna Convention on Road Traffic (automated driving systems)
issuer: Président de la République / Ministère de l'Europe et des affaires étrangères
notes: Gives domestic effect to new art. 34bis of the Vienna Convention under which an automated driving system may satisfy the requirement of a driver; triggers application of French STRA rules.

title_original: Arrêté du 2 août 2022 portant application de l'article R. 3152-3 du code des transports relatif à l'habilitation des intervenants à distance dans le cadre des systèmes de transport routier automatisé
title_en: Order of 2 August 2022 on the qualification of remote operators of automated road transport systems (art. R. 3152-3 Code des transports)
notes: Medical fitness, training and competence certificates for remote intervention operators and supervisors of driverless shuttles/robotaxi services (NOR TRET2223078A).

title_original: Arrêté du 2 août 2022 pris en application de l'article R. 3152-30 du code des transports, relatif à la procédure d'agrément des organismes qualifiés (systèmes de transport routier automatisé)
title_en: Order of 2 August 2022 on the approval procedure for qualified bodies assessing automated road transport systems (art. R. 3152-30 Code des transports)
notes: Requirements for organismes qualifiés agréés that audit safety demonstrations of automated road transport systems; processed by STRMTG (NOR TRET2219624A).

title_original: Arrêté du 8 décembre 2022 fixant le contenu et les modalités de fourniture de l'information obligatoire relative aux conditions d'utilisation du système de conduite automatisé équipant un véhicule
title_en: Order of 8 December 2022 on the mandatory consumer information about conditions of use of a vehicle's automated driving system
issuer: Ministre de l'économie (DGCCRF) et ministre chargé des transports
notes: Implements art. R.311-1 Code de la route: sellers/renters must inform consumers of the ADS operating conditions and limits (NOR ECOC2213191A).

title_original: Décret n° 2023-644 du 20 juillet 2023 relatif à l'accès à certaines données des véhicules pour la prévention des accidents, la connaissance de l'infrastructure routière et du trafic
title_en: Decree No. 2023-644 of 20 July 2023 on access to certain vehicle data for accident prevention, road infrastructure mapping and traffic knowledge
issuer: Premier ministre / Ministère chargé des transports
notes: Implementing decree of ordinance 2021-442: data access, retention and disclosure rules for connected/automated vehicle data (NOR TRET2311891D).

title_original: Décret n° 2024-1063 du 25 novembre 2024 relatif au transport routier automatisé de marchandises
title_en: Decree No. 2024-1063 of 25 November 2024 on automated road freight transport
issuer: Premier ministre / Ministère chargé des transports
notes: Extends the automated road transport system (STRA) safety regime to driverless freight vehicles: safety demonstration, roles of organiser/designer/operator (NOR PTDT2408874D).

title_original: Arrêté du 15 avril 2025 relatif à la sécurité de l'exploitation des systèmes de transport routier automatisés utilisant des véhicules totalement automatisés pour le transport en commun de personnes
title_en: Order of 15 April 2025 on operational safety of automated road transport systems using fully automated vehicles for public passenger transport
notes: Safety requirements for operating driverless shuttles/buses without onboard driver incl. remote interventions (NOR ATDT2509764A).

title_original: Développement des véhicules autonomes – Orientations stratégiques pour l'action publique (stratégie nationale, mai 2018)
title_en: Development of autonomous vehicles – Strategic orientations for public action (French national strategy, May 2018)
issuer: Gouvernement français (Haut responsable véhicule autonome, Anne-Marie Idrac)
notes: First French AV strategy: regulatory roadmap (liability, approval), experimentation programme (EVRA), cybersecurity, data and acceptability; superseded by 2020 and 2022 strategies.

title_original: Stratégie nationale de développement de la mobilité routière automatisée 2020-2022
title_en: National strategy for the development of automated road mobility 2020-2022
issuer: Gouvernement français – Ministère de la transition écologique
notes: Second national AV strategy prioritising automated shared mobility and freight services, completion of the legal framework (ordonnance 2021-443) and safety validation.

title_original: Stratégie nationale véhicule automatisé 2022-2025
title_en: National strategy for automated vehicles 2022-2025
issuer: Gouvernement français – Ministère de la transition écologique
notes: Third national strategy: deployment of automated transport services, regulatory completion (STRA, freight), European/UNECE engagement, industrial support.

title_original: Mobilités routières automatisées et connectées – Rapport de propositions / stratégie révisée 2025-2027 (avril 2025)
title_en: Automated and connected road mobility – proposals report / revised national strategy 2025-2027 (April 2025)
issuer: Gouvernement français – Ministère chargé des transports
notes: Revised strategy proposals for 2025-2027 covering automated passenger services, freight, regulatory simplification and industrial competitiveness.

title_original: Conseil d'État, juge des référés, ordonnance du 18 mai 2020, n° 440442 et 440445 (surveillance par drones – La Quadrature du Net et Ligue des droits de l'homme)
title_en: Council of State, urgent-applications judge, order of 18 May 2020, Nos. 440442 and 440445 (police drone surveillance during lockdown)
notes: Ordered the State to stop drone surveillance of lockdown compliance: drone footage is personal-data processing requiring a regulatory basis after CNIL opinion.

title_original: Conseil constitutionnel, décision n° 2021-817 DC du 20 mai 2021 – Loi pour une sécurité globale préservant les libertés (captation d'images par aéronefs circulant sans personne à bord)
title_en: Constitutional Council decision No. 2021-817 DC of 20 May 2021 – Global Security Law (image capture by unmanned aircraft)
notes: Struck down art. 47 provisions on police drone surveillance for lack of guarantees (duration, perimeter, number of devices) protecting privacy.

title_original: Conseil constitutionnel, décision n° 2021-834 DC du 20 janvier 2022 – Loi relative à la responsabilité pénale et à la sécurité intérieure (caméras aéroportées / drones)
title_en: Constitutional Council decision No. 2021-834 DC of 20 January 2022 – Law on criminal liability and internal security (airborne cameras / police drones)
notes: Validated with reservations the framework for State police drones (subsidiarity, no facial recognition), censured the emergency deployment and municipal police experimentation provisions.

title_original: Verordnung des Bundesministers für Verkehr, Innovation und Technologie über Rahmenbedingungen für automatisiertes Fahren (Automatisiertes Fahren Verordnung – AutomatFahrV), BGBl. II Nr. 402/2016 idF BGBl. II Nr. 66/2019, 143/2022, 287/2024
title_en: Ordinance of the Federal Minister for Transport on framework conditions for automated driving (Automated Driving Ordinance – AutomatFahrV), BGBl. II No. 402/2016 as amended
issuer: Bundesministerium für Verkehr, Innovation und Technologie (now BMIMI)
notes: Defines permitted automated driving use cases for testing and use on Austrian roads (motorway pilot, automated minibus, military vehicle, parking assistant), test driver duties, reporting to the.

title_original: Luftfahrtgesetz (LFG) – Bestimmungen über unbemannte Luftfahrzeuge (§§ 24c ff.)
title_en: Austrian Aviation Act (LFG) – provisions on unmanned aircraft (sections 24c ff.)
notes: LFG amendment 2014 (BGBl. I 108/2013) created the first Austrian drone categories (class 1/2 unmanned aircraft, Austro Control permits); amended 2020 to implement EU 2019/947; section numbers to.

title_original: Постановление Правительства Российской Федерации от 26 ноября 2018 г. № 1415 «О проведении эксперимента по опытной эксплуатации на автомобильных дорогах общего пользования высокоавтоматизированных транспортных средств»
title_en: Government of the Russian Federation Decree No. 1415 of 26 November 2018 on an experiment with trial operation of highly automated vehicles on public roads
source_database: legalacts.ru mirror (official pravo.gov.ru ID not located)
notes: Launched the first Russian on-road AV experiment (Moscow, Tatarstan; extended 2020 to 11 regions) with safety driver, NAMI testing and insurance; expired 2022 and replaced by experimental legal.

title_original: Федеральный закон от 31 июля 2020 г. № 258-ФЗ «Об экспериментальных правовых режимах в сфере цифровых инноваций в Российской Федерации»
title_en: Federal Law No. 258-FZ of 31 July 2020 on Experimental Legal Regimes in the Field of Digital Innovation in the Russian Federation
notes: Regulatory sandbox law under which Russia established experimental legal regimes for driverless vehicles (Moscow, federal highways), drone delivery and medical AI.

title_original: Распоряжение Правительства РФ от 25 марта 2020 г. № 724-р об утверждении Концепции обеспечения безопасности дорожного движения с участием беспилотных транспортных средств на автомобильных дорогах общего пользования
title_en: Government Order No. 724-r of 25 March 2020 approving the Concept for ensuring road traffic safety with the participation of unmanned vehicles on public roads
notes: Federal concept setting principles and stages for safe introduction of highly automated vehicles, liability allocation, technical regulation and infrastructure to 2025.

title_original: Распоряжение Правительства РФ от 21 июня 2023 г. № 1630-р об утверждении Стратегии развития беспилотной авиации Российской Федерации на период до 2030 года и на перспективу до 2035 года
title_en: Government Order No. 1630-r of 21 June 2023 approving the Strategy for the Development of Unmanned Aviation of the Russian Federation to 2030 with outlook to 2035
notes: National UAS strategy underpinning the 2024 national project on unmanned aviation systems: certification, airspace integration, domestic production, regulatory sandboxes.

title_original: Projet de loi relative aux véhicules routiers à conduite automatisée (Luxembourg, 2025) – mise en œuvre de la stratégie « Automatiséiert Fueren 2028 »
title_en: Draft law on automated-driving road vehicles (Luxembourg, 2025) – implementing the 'Automatiséiert Fueren 2028' strategy
issuer: Gouvernement du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg (Ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics)
notes: Comprehensive bill defining automation levels, declaration of entry into service, duties of manufacturers/drivers/remote operators, automated transport services, data and criminal liability.

title_original: Arrêté du Gouvernement en Conseil du 25 octobre 2024 déterminant la composition et le fonctionnement du comité interministériel de coordination pour la conduite automatisée
title_en: Government-in-Council Order of 25 October 2024 determining the composition and functioning of the interministerial coordination committee for automated driving
notes: Creates the interministerial committee coordinating Luxembourg's automated driving policy and test authorisations (members appointed by order of 22 Nov 2024).

title_original: Règlement grand-ducal du 22 décembre 2025 relatif aux aéronefs sans équipage à bord
title_en: Grand-Ducal Regulation of 22 December 2025 on unmanned aircraft
issuer: Grand-Duc / Ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics
notes: National drone regulation complementing EU 2019/947: geographic zones, operator obligations and national procedures for unmanned aircraft in Luxembourg airspace.

title_original: Ustawa z dnia 14 grudnia 2018 r. o zmianie ustawy – Prawo lotnicze oraz niektórych innych ustaw (Dz.U. 2019 poz. 235) – bezzałogowe statki powietrzne
title_en: Act of 14 December 2018 amending the Aviation Law and certain other acts (Dz.U. 2019 item 235) – unmanned aircraft provisions
notes: Aviation Law amendment (in force 1 Apr 2019) adding statutory rules for unmanned aircraft: operator/pilot requirements, BVLOS, PAŻP coordination, sanctions; basis for Polish UAS regulations.

title_original: Ustawa z dnia 3 lipca 2026 r. o systemach sztucznej inteligencji (Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1003)
title_en: Act of 3 July 2026 on Artificial Intelligence Systems (Dz.U. 2026 item 1003)
notes: National AI Act implementing EU Regulation 2024/1689 (market surveillance authority, sandboxes, penalties); applies to AI in robots/vehicles only via the EU high-risk framework.

title_original: Vize rozvoje autonomní mobility (usnesení vlády ČR č. 720 ze dne 11. října 2017)
title_en: Vision for the development of autonomous mobility (Czech Government Resolution No. 720 of 11 October 2017)
notes: First Czech government strategy on automated vehicles: testing framework, legal and ethical issues, infrastructure, cooperation with industry; led to the 2024 Plan.

title_original: Real Decreto 517/2024, de 4 de junio, por el que se desarrolla el régimen jurídico para la utilización civil de sistemas de aeronaves no tripuladas (UAS)
title_en: Royal Decree 517/2024 of 4 June developing the legal regime for the civil use of unmanned aircraft systems (UAS)
issuer: Gobierno de España (Ministerio de Transportes y Movilidad Sostenible)
notes: Completes EU 2019/947 in Spain: operator obligations, insurance, training entities, geographic zones, registry; in force 25 June 2024, largely replacing RD 1036/2017.

title_original: Νόμος 4784/2021 «Η Ελλάδα σε κίνηση: Βιώσιμη Αστική Κινητικότητα – Μικροκινητικότητα – Ρυθμίσεις για τον εκσυγχρονισμό, την απλούστευση και την ψηφιοποίηση διαδικασιών του Υπουργείου Υποδομών και Μεταφορών» (ΦΕΚ Α' 40/16-3-2021)
title_en: Law 4784/2021 'Greece in motion: Sustainable urban mobility – micromobility – modernisation of Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport procedures' (FEK A 40/16-3-2021)
notes: Cited as the statutory basis for pilot testing of automated vehicles in Greece (amendments to the Road Traffic Code enabling ministerial decisions on AV trials); FEK PDF via ELINYAE mirror.

title_original: Υπουργική Απόφαση 393352/2022 – Όροι και προϋποθέσεις δοκιμαστικής κυκλοφορίας αυτόνομων οχημάτων (ΦΕΚ Β' 6414/15-12-2022)
title_en: Ministerial Decision 393352/2022 – terms and conditions for pilot operation of autonomous vehicles (FEK B 6414/15-12-2022)
notes: Application procedure for research pilot programmes with automated vehicles (five phases, safety operator in phases 1–3, insurance, risk assessment, proving-ground pre-tests); official FEK URL not.

title_original: Проект Закону про внесення змін до Повітряного кодексу України щодо удосконалення законодавчого врегулювання у сфері безпілотних повітряних суден цивільної авіації (реєстр. № 3716)
title_en: Draft Law amending the Air Code of Ukraine to improve the legislative regulation of civil unmanned aircraft (reg. No. 3716)
issuer: Верховна Рада України (народний депутат П. Павловський)
notes: Bill creating a statutory framework for civil UAS in the Air Code (registration, operator categories, airspace use); awaiting second reading per government bill tracker.

title_original: Decreto-Lei n.º 58/2018, de 23 de julho – regime de registo e seguro de responsabilidade civil obrigatório para aeronaves não tripuladas (drones)
title_en: Decree-Law No. 58/2018 of 23 July – registration and compulsory civil liability insurance regime for unmanned aircraft (drones)
issuer: Governo de Portugal (Presidência do Conselho de Ministros)
notes: Requires registration of UAS above 250 g and liability insurance for drones over 900 g; complements ANAC Regulation 1093/2016; page is JS-rendered so title verified from secondary sources.

title_original: Regulamento n.º 1093/2016 da ANAC, de 14 de dezembro – condições de operação aplicáveis à utilização do espaço aéreo pelos sistemas de aeronaves civis pilotadas remotamente (drones)
title_en: ANAC Regulation No. 1093/2016 of 14 December – operating conditions for use of airspace by civil remotely piloted aircraft systems (drones)
notes: Portugal's first drone operating rules (120 m ceiling, VLOS, no-fly zones, ANAC authorisations); superseded by EU 2019/947 implementation; page is JS-rendered, title from secondary sources.

title_original: SHGM İnsansız Hava Aracı Sistemleri Talimatı (SHT-İHA) ve İHA kayıt sistemi
title_en: Turkish DGCA Instruction on Unmanned Aircraft Systems (SHT-UAV) and UAV registration system
notes: National UAS instruction (first issued 2016, revised 2017/2019/2021): weight classes İHA0–İHA3, registration, pilot licensing, operating limits; direct PDF not reachable from sandbox.
